Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.paymentexecution

Record Class KfeSubmitTransactionRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.paymentexecution.KfeSubmitTransactionRequest
Record Components:
idempotencyKey - caller-generated key used to make retries safe
rail - payment rail selected for execution
direction - transfer direction from the user's perspective
sourceWalletId - wallet funding an outgoing transaction, when required
destinationWalletId - internal destination wallet, when the transfer is internal
amountSats - positive gross transfer amount in satoshis
networkFeeSats - non-negative network or provider fee estimate in satoshis
externalReference - rail destination such as an address or invoice
memo - optional user-visible memo, limited to 255 characters
totpCode - optional one-time password for step-up authorization
passkeyAssertionJson - optional serialized WebAuthn assertion
confirmationPassphrase - optional transaction confirmation passphrase
appPin - optional application PIN for transaction confirmation
paymentRequestPublicId - linked payment request public identifier, if applicable
feeRateSatPerVbyte - explicit on-chain fee rate from the selected fee tier
feeTargetBlocks - confirmation target associated with the selected fee tier
quoteId - persistent quote identifier binding the price and fees to this request
public record KfeSubmitTransactionRequest(@NotBlank String idempotencyKey, @NotNull KfeRail rail, @NotNull KfeDirection direction, UUID sourceWalletId, UUID destinationWalletId, @jakarta.validation.constraints.Min(1L) long amountSats, @jakarta.validation.constraints.Min(0L) long networkFeeSats, String externalReference, @Size(max=255) String memo, String totpCode, String passkeyAssertionJson, String confirmationPassphrase, String appPin, @Size(max=48) String paymentRequestPublicId, Long feeRateSatPerVbyte, Integer feeTargetBlocks, String quoteId) extends Record
Validated API input for creating an idempotent payment or transfer transaction. Authentication factors are transient request data and must never be persisted or echoed.
